channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump says Israel, Hezbollah to stop fighting: What we know
item.description: Netanyahu agrees to halt operations near Beirut; Hezbollah to stop attacks on Israel under new truce arrangement.

item.title: Refugee women in CAR face childbirth risks amid US funding cuts
item.description: Limited staffing and supplies force pregnant women in CAR to give birth at home, increasing risks of preventable deaths.

item.title: How the war has made Iran’s water crisis worse
item.description: Attacks on desalination plants and other water infrastructure by US and Israel have further added to the water woes.

item.title: World Cup: No ICE deployment; extra security for Iran games in Los Angeles
item.description: Federal agents will be present during the World Cup, but immigration enforcement will not occur, county sheriff says.

item.title: How does Iran’s leadership view the emerging deal with the US?
item.description: Iranian authorities reject capitulation, but there are subtle differences between various factions.

item.title: Mozambique says 5 citizens killed in ‘xenophobic attacks’ in South Africa
item.description: The violence prompted 300 Mozambicans to return home over the weekend.

item.title: At least 12 people killed, dozens wounded in Russian attacks on Ukraine
item.description: Russia launched 656 drones and 73 missiles at Ukraine overnight, according to Ukraine's air force.

item.title: Iran war day 95: Trump pushes Lebanon truce after Tehran vows to end talks
item.description: Trump says he persuaded Israel and Hezbollah to halt attacks, seeking to prevent a wider war in Lebanon.

item.title: Ukraine rescuers pull dead from rubble after Russian strikes kill 18 people
item.description: An eight-year-old boy and a woman killed in a strike on an apartment block are among the dead, officials say.

item.title: Clashes continue in Lebanon despite Israel and Hezbollah accepting US partial ceasefire plan
item.description: A cessation of hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah is seen as crucial to the peace process with Iran.
